t.E460.agn: In 2018 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E460.body: Celluloses are not absorbed and are largely excreted unchanged in faeces; part of them may be fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E460.prod: It is obtained from plant fibre mechanically (powdered cellulose) or by acid treatment (microcrystalline cellulose).
t.E460.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E460.summary: Cellulose, the main building block of plant fibres. In powders it prevents caking, and it is a bulking agent in products such as grated cheese.
t.E460.what: It prevents caking and is used as a bulking agent and source of fibre.
